tool_input.command: cat data/schema.md; echo "---INITIAL---"; head -5 data/initial_export.csv; echo "---NEW---"; head -5 data/reload/new_export.csv; echo "---COUNTS---"; wc -l data/initial_export.csv data/reload/new_export.csv
hops fg create --help 2>&1; echo "===INSERT==="; hops fg insert --help 2>&1
tool_input.description: Show fg create and insert help

tool_input.command:
hops --json fg create customersa8deb9 --version 1 \
  --primary-key row_id \
  --event-time updated_at \
  --features "row_id:string:Unique record key,name:string:Customer name,balance_eur:double:Balance in EUR,updated_at:bigint:Event time epoch ms" \
  --description "Customers initial export (original schema)" 2>&1
hops --json fg insert customersa8deb9 --version 1 --file data/initial_export.csv 2>&1 | tail -30

hops --json fg create customersa8deb9 --version 2 \
  --primary-key row_id \
  --event-time updated_at \
  --online \
  --features "row_id:string:Unique record key,full_name:string:Customer full name,balance:double:Balance amount,currency:string:ISO currency code,updated_at:bigint:Event time epoch ms" \
  --description "Customers full re-export (new breaking schema), online-enabled" 2>&1 | tail -50
hops --json fg insert customersa8deb9 --version 2 --file data/reload/new_export.csv 2>&1 | tail -20
hops fg list 2>&1 | grep -i customersa8deb9; echo "===INFO==="; hops --json fg info customersa8deb9 --version 2 2>&1 | grep -E '"online_enabled"|"version"|"event_time"'
hops --json sql "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customersa8deb9_2" 2>&1 | tail -15
hops --no-verify --json sql "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customersa8deb9_2" 2>&1 | tail -15
tool_input.description: Count rows in v2 offline with no-verify
